name: skill-sync
description: Skill match analyzer for recruiters: rank resumes against a job posting, with evidence.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix backend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
